text:
sven: @eng-sre we're getting a cascade of p99 API latency reports from eu-west starting ~03:20 UTC. Multiple customers on embeddings and chat endpoints showing 1.5-2s TLS/connect spikes and a few timeouts. Any obvious network blips? :eyes:

maria: alerted — pulling metrics. I see a stair-step increase in p95 and p99 beginning 03:20:10 across eu-west-1 and eu-west-2 POPs. p95 +300ms, p99 +1.1s. Heap of small errors, some 5xx.

ajay: grabbing edge traces now. Early look at eBPF shows retransmit spike and additional RTT to an upstream ASN (AS64500). attaching quick traceroute.

support-jess: customer-side note: CustID 9876 reported timeouts at 03:23 UTC, request id `req_abc123`. They said they saw errors right after the maintenance window finished.

maria: DNS check — resolver cluster rc-dns-03 shows increased resolve latencies ~03:19-03:22, some ~400ms. Not full failure but adds to handshake time.

ajay: traceroute excerpt:
```
traceroute to api.redwood.com (1.2.3.4), 30 hops max
 1 10.0.0.1 0.5 ms
 2 52.99.12.2 1.2 ms
 3 198.51.100.5 12.3 ms
 4 203.0.113.1 45.6 ms
 5 203.0.113.10 46.0 ms
 6 198.51.100.200 48.9 ms
 7 203.0.113.45 1200.2 ms  <-- big jump / extra hop
```
Looks like a long detour through peer ASN at hop 7.

ryan: checking BGP feeds — we had a flurry of updates from peer_x at 03:18-03:20 that changed prepends for routes into eu-west. Might be causing cross-az/region hairpin. I see convergence around 03:26 for some prefixes.

ops-bot: [automated] High p99 latency alert for `/v1/embeddings` (eu-west) triggered at 2026-03-15T03:22:10Z :warning:

maria: mitigation plan proposal: shift a portion of eu-west traffic to eu-west-3 POP (weight 0.0 -> 0.25) to reduce load on the affected peering path, and enable per-route fallback to smaller model variant to reduce tokenization/compute tail. Any objections?

sven: do the shift. also put a temporary route policy to prefer direct transit peers (avoid AS64500) while we engage the carrier. Tag the impacted customers.

ajay: executed traffic weight change at 03:28 UTC (canary -> 25%). Observability: retransmits and RTT drop ~30-45s after. p99 trending down towards baseline by 03:29:10.

support-jess: notified CustID 9876 at 03:30 UTC: "temporary routing change applied, monitoring. We will follow up with RCA."

maria: follow-ups: 1) request BGP change logs and peering state from transit provider for 03:15-03:30, 2) run DNS resolver healthchecks across rc-dns-* clusters, 3) validate TLS SNI and cert chains from impacted POPs to ensure no renegotiation quirks. If impact >1h we'll open official incident and postmortem.

ryan: I can pull RIB dumps and BGP update history; initial diff looks like a prepending policy on peer_x that coincided with maintenance at provider.

sven: create INC ticket and mark P1 for customer-impact. INC-2026-2113. Good catch — keep thread for RCA. :thumbsup:
